import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature/src/types/checker/functions/call_validation.rs')
t = p.read_text()
old = '''    /// Normalizes arguments for a builtin or extern function call, rejecting unknown named
    /// arguments and not allowing unknown named arguments to flow into the variadic parameter.
    /// Normalizes a builtin call and reports which slots the NORMALIZER filled.'''
new = '''    /// Normalizes a builtin or extern call and reports which slots the NORMALIZER filled.
    ///
    /// Unknown named arguments are rejected rather than flowing into the variadic parameter.'''
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(t.replace(old, new))
print('doc comment merged')
